{{Quote|Why, that rotten Mars!|[[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]]|<ref name="Podracing Tales">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
'''Mars Guo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] who piloted [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. He had a propensity for heavy drinking and pretty women, and his loud mouth frequently got him into trouble. He would often pick fights with the local riffraff of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] despite his diminutive stature, which constantly led to his own defeat.

==Biography==
[[File:Mars_guo.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Mars Guo during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].]]
{{Quote|First time, big time ... Mars Guo!|Fode|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
Mars wasn't the best [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] on the circuit, but he had made quite a name for himself in the [[minor rim leagues]], and he felt confident that he could pull off a victory in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Unfortunately, he made the mistake of imbibing one too many drinks at [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor's]] glimmik concert the previous night, and the even worse mistake of hitting on one of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] masseuses, [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]]. The [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]], who had long been infatuated with Ann, overheard this encounter.

Outraged, he reported the incident to Sebulba the next day, who responded by subtly sabotaging Guo's [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. During the second lap, Sebulba was vexed by the fact that Guo's [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]] [[Plug-2 Behemoth|Plug-2 ''Behemoth'']] was still in the running, and to finish the matter he broke off a small bit of his pod and tossed it behind him into one of Guo's colossal engines. The craft was shattered and Guo's pod was sent flying.

Many believed this was the end of the swaggering [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], but Mars managed to survive and limped back to his home planet of [[Phu/Legends|Phu]], but unfortunately wasn't able to buy Ann Gella. However, while he was being attended in a medcenter, a bitter Sebulba persuaded race officials to put all of Guo's belongings to be auctioned, including his two [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mechanics, [[Pax Bonkik|Pax]] and [[Trax Bonkik]], although Pax was purchased by [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] prior to the auction. It was a long time before he showed up on the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] circuit again.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You're gonna fry!|Mars Guo was voiced by [[Jim Ward (voice actor)|Jim Ward]]|translated=1|audio=MarsGuo-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
In the revised [[Star Wars: Episode I The Beginning|rough draft]] of the script for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], "Marso Guo" is said to be from [[Ophuchi]].<ref name="DB2">{{DB|organization|boontapodrace|Boonta Eve Classic Podracers}}</ref>

[[File:Mars_Guo_upstaged.png|thumb|right|280px|In a deleted scene animated for the DVD release of ''The Phantom Menace'', Mars Guo is upstaged by Jar Jar Binks.]]
For the [[Star Wars home video releases|DVD release]] of ''The Phantom Menace'', [[Industrial Light & Magic]] animated an additional scene featuring Guo as a fully computer-generated character.<ref name="DB" /> In the sequence, Guo salutes the crowd after his name is announced over the loudspeakers by [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]. However, an oblivious [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] upstages the Phuii by standing in front of him and trying to get the attention of another podracer, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TPM scene">{{Film|I}}, deleted scenes.</ref> 

[[File:Mars_guo_cutscene.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Guo as he appeared in the deleted scene.]]
While the model of Guo shown in [[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]] has orange eyes with slit pupils, the CG Guo in the ''The Phantom Menace'' deleted scene has white eyes with round pupils.

Guo appears as a playable character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''; his podracer has a top speed higher than his competitors, but he has only average or low ratings at acceleration, air brakes, and cooling.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer" /> In contrast, in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[Wizards of the Coast]], Guo lags behind most of his competitors in piloting and repair skills; his pod is slow, albeit fairly durable.<ref name="SOT ">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> Guo appears in the Podracing portion of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'' as a contestant in the [[Destiny Hub]] race, although not as a playable character.<ref name="KSW">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>
